fields.description: DigiTax Zambia API base URL, without the /v1 suffix.
fields.label: Server URL

fields.description: Filled automatically from DigiTax when the API key is saved. Whether data goes to the ZRA sandbox or to live ZRA depends on the API key, not on a setting here.
fields.label: DigiTax Business

fields.description: Whether the business has been initialised successfully on DigiTax.
fields.label: Initialised on DigiTax

fields.description: Sandbox only. Public base URL DigiTax should call back to, e.g. an ngrok URL like https://abc123.ngrok-free.app when the site runs on localhost. Leave empty to use this site's URL.
fields.label: Callback Base URL

fields.description: Auto creates the "Branch" Accounting Dimension which will be mandatory for all P&L transactions. Recommended.
fields.label: Auto Create Branch Accounting Dimension

fields.description: X-API-Key generated under Integrations on the DigiTax dashboard.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Register items with DigiTax automatically when they are saved with all SIS fields filled in.
fields.label: Auto Register Items

fields.description: Register customers with DigiTax automatically when they are saved with a TPIN and a phone number.
fields.label: Auto Register Customers

fields.description: Register suppliers with DigiTax automatically when they are saved with a TPIN.
fields.label: Auto Register Suppliers
Send Sales Invoices to ZRA
fields.description: Record every submitted Sales Invoice, credit note and debit note dated on or after the Go-Live Date in the ZRA SIS Sales Ledger and send it to ZRA. Submitting is never blocked: invoices that cannot be sent yet wait in the ledger with the reason.

fields.label: Sales Submission Frequency
fields.options:
All
Hourly
Daily
Weekly
Monthly
Yearly
Annual
Cron

fields.description: Defines the allowed period for entries to be sent to SIS, such as invoices and purchases, from the current time. For example, if set to 4 days, entries can only be sent within the last 4 days.
fields.label: Sales

fields.description: How many times the hourly job resends a sale DigiTax rejected (for example for low stock) before it waits for a manual Retry.
fields.label: Automatic Retries for Rejected Sales
Report Stock Movements
fields.description: Send stock movements of registered stock items to DigiTax.

fields.label: Go-Live Date
fields.description: Stock movements and sales dated before this are not sent.

fields.label: Pull Purchases and Imports
fields.description: Fetch purchases and import items from DigiTax every 4 hours. They can also be fetched from their list views.

fields.label: Send Purchase Invoices to ZRA
fields.description: Send every submitted Purchase Invoice with registered items to ZRA as a purchase (POST /purchases), which adds its stock on DigiTax. Leave off to report purchase stock as stock movements instead. Invoices created from a ZRA purchase or ticked Is Import are never sent.

fields.label: Default Payment Type
fields.options:
01 - Cash
02 - Credit
03 - Cash/Credit
04 - Bank Check
05 - Debit & Credit Card
06 - Mobile Money
07 - Other
fields.description: Sent for paid invoices whose payment type is not known from the invoice or its POS payments.
